objectives: This course focuses on fundamental mathematics and computer programming for students in applied geology. Specific topics will include Python program language and the applications of computer code to solve mathematical problems with numerical methods.
content:
1.	Introduction and software installation for the Python programming environment
2.	Variables, operations, and I/O
3.	Statistical analysis and graphical visualization in Python
4.	Systems of linear algebraic equations
5.	Interpolation and curve fitting
6.	Numerical integration
7.	Solving ordinary differential equations (ODEs)
8.	Solving partial differential equations (PDEs)
9.	Introduction to machine learning models
teaching_method:
講授
研討
實習/實驗

distribution_conditions.rule: 系所:限應用地質研究所碩士班、應用地質研究所博士班。
